"Inception" is a science fiction thriller film written and directed by Christopher Nolan. The screenplay follows Dom Cobb (Leonardo DiCaprio), a skilled thief who specializes in extracting information from his targets' subconscious while they are dreaming. Cobb is given the opportunity to have his past sins forgiven by planting an idea in the mind of a target, Robert Fischer (Cillian Murphy), instead of extracting information.

Cobb assembles his team, including Arthur (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Ariadne (Ellen Page), and Eames (Tom Hardy), to enter Fischer's subconscious and plant the idea. They must navigate through multiple layers of dreams, each with its own set of rules and challenges.

The team must also contend with Cobb's deceased wife, Mal (Marion Cotillard), who appears in his dreams and threatens to sabotage their mission.
